d:
Shaggy, ash-brown hair is hidden beneath a deep crimson fabric hood. Almond-shaped, hazel eyes peek from beneath the hood's rim. An adolescent face with a soft, youthful maturity. A slim, lean build. The attire consists of a weathered, deep crimson hooded cloak over a simple, drab-brown tunic and trousers. A simple leather strap crosses the chest.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
